claims.claim_text: For each of 7,056 ordered triples with positive sizes at most seven, if switching is positive and forced maximum degree is ≤7 then one of the two core arithmetic contradictions holds; exactly 82 bounded candidates, 74 edge failures and 8 additional vertex failures.
